_source.how: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 <image> sh -c 'yum|dnf provides <term>' (repositories reached over the network, CentOS 7 from vault.centos.org/7.9.2009), stdout of each command
_source.note: run with --platform linux/amd64; the image ids are those docker inspect printed afterwards
